name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations: surface, underground or elevated, with five lengths and covered platforms.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.14.2 replaces the missing elevated entrance decoration with a native park bench facing the street, beside the clear central walking route. Native mesh and material references use the base-game namespace. The previous entrance resource ID is retained. Elevated pier spacing, paved plaza, continuous track bed, station layouts, speeds and pedestrian paths are unchanged from 0.14.1, whose operation was confirmed in-game. All five platform lengths, surface/underground/elevated placements, through/terminus layouts and approach fence choices remain available. The new bench appearance still requires in-game confirmation. Do not remove the mod while its infrastructure remains in a save.
